title: Grateful Dead Live at Greek Theatre, U. Of California on 1982-05-23
source: Matrix by Hunter Seamons using Final Cut Pro (FLAC>AIFF>Final Cut>WAV>FLAC)

ai_review.summary: High‑energy show captured in a clear matrix mix with Bob’s guitar upfront and overall great sound
ai_review.review: The reviewers rave about the electric vibe of this performance, calling it one of their favorites. The matrix recording is praised for its clarity—Bob Weir’s rhythm guitar sits front‑and‑center while Jerry’s lead balances out after a few early mix quirks, resulting in an enjoyable listening experience.

ai_rating.rationale: A single detailed 5‑star review highlights both an energetic show and a well‑balanced matrix recording; the strong positive feedback yields a high rating, but confidence is medium due to limited sample size.

recording_quality.technical_notes: Bob’s guitar is prominently upfront; Jerry’s guitar sits low in the mix on "Shakedown" and "Promised Land" but levels out later, overall a clean and pleasant sounding recording.

band_member_comments.Jerry: Guitar low in mix on "Shakedown" and "Promised Land", evened out later.
band_member_comments.Bob: Rhythm guitar is very upfront in the matrix mix, adding to the energetic feel.
